both.description: Also block requests that would send a secret to the server (same as --both).

allowPlaceholders.description: Let requests containing "[REDACTED:...]" through. Not recommended: a model could overwrite real secrets on disk.

maxStringLength.description: Truncate string values longer than this, after redaction. 0 = off.

disable.description: Rule ids to turn off everywhere.

categories.description: Only apply rules of these categories.

allow.description: Exact values that are never redacted, e.g. your support address or a test card number.

allowPatterns.description: Regexes that keep a detected value when they match ALL of it.

rules.description: Your own detection rules, applied after the built-ins.

label.description: Placeholder label; default is the id upper-cased.

pattern.description: JavaScript regex source, without slashes. Keep repetition bounded.

minEntropy.description: Skip matches below this Shannon entropy (bits per character).

tools.description: Per-tool policies, keyed by MCP tool name.

disable.description: Rule ids to turn off for this tool only.

dryRun.description: Report what would be redacted or blocked, but change nothing.

auditLog.description: Append a JSONL audit log here (relative to this file). Never contains values.

anyOf.description: The id of one of your custom rules.
